STRIPE_MODE=test appears only in the checkout-config 503 (publishable key does not match). That is Stripe env mismatch, not a database identity proof. Mixed/broken preview env argues against treating the DB as clearly staging.

src/vacation/auth.mjs requireIntakeAuth is a no-op when TIMESYNCHER_INTAKE_TOKEN is unset. Prior POST /api/vacation-request with invalid JSON returned 400 Request body must be valid JSON (not 401), so a valid JSON POST would insert customer/trip/request rows into whatever Neon this preview uses.
api/vacation-request.mjs upserts customer and trip before validating request text. Even {} would insert rows. Bind lane did not POST any valid JSON create body.

Locking TREK 90 / travel.timesyncher.com/shared/las-vegas-strip-vacation/ would point SCT at the public production TREK research workspace. Not staging-safe.
